mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and this applies going forward. Development and testing that needs to talk to TLS endpoints uses self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
